name: TheraminM5 - Tilt-Reactive Theremin
author: coreymillia + GitHub Copilot CLI
description: Motion-controlled theremin with psychedelic Hector 3D visuals. Tilt left/right for pitch, forward/back for volume. Features real-time frequency synthesis and reactive waveform animations. v1.3: Smooth continuous audio with 50ms tone bursts.
features: 🎶 SMOOTH AUDIO - v1.3 continuous tone improvement

audio_specs.v1.3_improvement: Continuous 50ms tone bursts eliminate audio stuttering

visual_specs.wave_function: Theremin-reactive cosine waves with tilt warping

gameplay.objective: Create music by tilting the device
gameplay.visual_feedback: Colors change with frequency, waves respond to volume
gameplay.practice_mode: Turn sound off to practice movements with visual feedback only

installation.note: Single file contains bootloader, partitions, and firmware

usage_instructions: 1. Flash firmware using M5Burner with MERGED.bin
2. Power on - visual animation starts immediately
3. Press BtnA to turn sound ON (shows green 'ON' indicator)
6. Watch on-screen display for real-time values
7. Press BtnB to cycle through visual styles
8. Hold power button to see help screen
9. Press BtnA again to turn sound OFF
tips_and_strategies: Start with device flat to find center pitch
Tilt slowly for smooth frequency changes
Tilt backward (toward you) for maximum volume
Use visual feedback to learn tilt ranges
Practice with sound off to master movements
Grid mode shows wave structure best
Hold device steady for sustained notes

inspired_by.color_theory: HSV color space for frequency mapping

version_history.1.3.0: SMOOTH AUDIO - Fixed audio stuttering with 50ms continuous tone bursts, removed frequency change threshold for seamless playback
version_history.1.2.0: Improved frequency mapping and visual feedback
version_history.1.1.0: Enhanced IMU smoothing and volume control
version_history.1.0.0: Initial release: Full theremin controls with tilt sensing, 3 visual modes, real-time synthesis, psychedelic Hector visuals
